item.title: Valve: Steam Frame Doesn’t Support Stereoscopic Rendering of Flat Games but the Feature is “on our list”
item.description: Valve says that Steam Frame won’t be able to display traditional (‘flat’) games in stereoscopic 3D at launch, but they are looking into the feature for future development. item.title: ‘Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow’ Review – So Close to Stealing My Heart

item.title: Apple Design Lead Heads to Meta, Hopefully to Fix Longstanding Quest UX Issues
item.description: Apple’s Vice President of Human Interface design, Alan Dye, is leaving the company to lead a new studio within Meta’s Reality Labs division. item.title: HTC ‘VIVERSE’ Immersive Social Platform Hits 1 Million Monthly-active Users
item.description: HTC announced today that its VIVERSE immersive social platform has reached 1 million monthly-active users, a major milestone. The platform is accessible on flatscreens and VR, so it’s unclear what portion of users are visiting with headsets. The News HTC’s Viverse is a user-generated immersive social platform, quite similar to Meta’s Horizon Worlds.
